headline: Spotify Q2 Earnings Miss on Higher Marketing and AI Costs
summary: SPOT's Q2 earnings miss estimates as higher marketing, cloud and AI costs offset record margins, subscriber gains and stronger cash flow.

headline: Is Verisk Analytics (VRSK) an Undervalued Data Monopoly in Insurance?
